description: Where does a whole list of courses and exams land at ONE receiving school? One item in, one stated answer out, in the order asked: the rules this build holds for each - the school's own catalog, a transfer agreement, and CourseAtlas's rules as ingested, which carry their CourseAtlas ids. CourseAtlas is not read live per item here; a caller that reads it live merges on those shared ids, where the two sources agreeing is corroboration. CourseShelf and CourseAtlas are equal reference sources: neither outranks the other. An item whose school or course is not held says so and the other items still answer. An exam is read by its exam node, whatever its wording; an exam that fits none, or more than one, answers its `candidates` to choose from, never a guess. Comparable, never equivalent. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.

items.description: What was taken: each item a course (its school by unitid or name, with code or title) or an exam (exam_program with exam). At most 60 in one call.

code.description: The course code as printed, e.g. HIST 201

exam.description: For an exam: the exam as printed, by title or code

exam_program.description: For an exam: its program, e.g. AP

item_id.description: Optional: the caller's own id for this item, echoed back; the position is used when absent

school.description: Or: the course's school, by name

title.description: Or: the course title, matched exactly

unitid.description: The course's school, by IPEDS UNITID

limit.description: Optional page size per item's rules (default 10, at most 50)

target_unitid.description: The receiving school, by IPEDS UNITID

name: comparability_for_courses
title: Comparability for Many Courses
